mapper.sql: T.TRIAL_NO, T.BUSINESS_NO, B.ORG_NAME, TD.DISEASE_NO, D.DISEASE_NAME, T.TITLE, T.PHASE, T.RECRUITMENT_STATUS, T.BRIEF_SUMMARY, T.ELIGIBILITY_TEXT, T.ENROLLMENT_TARGET, T.INSTITUTION_NAME, T.LOCATION_TEXT, T.CONTACT_NAME, T.CONTACT_PHONE, T.CONTACT_EMAIL, T.START_DATE_TEXT, T.COMPLETION_DATE_TEXT, T.REVIEW_STATUS, T.REJECT_REASON, T.CREATED_AT, T.UPDATED_AT
mapper.select: SELECT FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = T.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN TRIAL_DISEASE TD ON TD.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO LEFT JOIN DISEASE D ON D.DISEASE_NO = TD.DISEASE_NO WHERE T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED') ORDER BY CASE T.REVIEW_STATUS WHEN 'PENDING' THEN 1 WHEN 'REJECTED' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END, NVL(T.UPDATED_AT, T.CREATED_AT) DESC, T.TRIAL_NO DESC

SELECT FROM CLINICAL_TRIAL T JOIN BUSINESS B ON B.BUSINESS_NO = T.BUSINESS_NO LEFT JOIN TRIAL_DISEASE TD ON TD.TRIAL_NO = T.TRIAL_NO LEFT JOIN DISEASE D ON D.DISEASE_NO = TD.DISEASE_NO WHERE T.TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND T.SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND T.REVIEW_STATUS IN ('PENDING', 'APPROVED', 'REJECTED')
mapper.update: UPDATE CLINICAL_TRIAL SET REVIEW_STATUS = 'APPROVED', REJECT_REASON = NULL, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'PENDING'

UPDATE CLINICAL_TRIAL SET REVIEW_STATUS = 'REJECTED', REJECT_REASON = #{rejectReason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_AT = SYSDATE WHERE TRIAL_NO = #{trialNo} AND SOURCE_TYPE = 'BUSINESS' AND REVIEW_STATUS = 'PENDING'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG ( REVIEW_LOG_NO, ADMIN_MEMBER_NO, TARGET_TYPE, TARGET_NO, ACTION_TYPE, REASON, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( SEQ_ADMIN_REVIEW_LOG.NEXTVAL, #{adminMemberNo}, 'TRIAL', #{trialNo}, #{actionType}, #{reason,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE )
